notes.title: Update 0.1.6
notes.notes:
Hey fellow orcs,

I've released two new updates 0.1.5 and 0.1.6 for the free demo here on Steam, which consist of a bunch of fixes and also some minor balancing. Especially a bug where customers weren't able to visit the inn is now gone. You can also place a guidepost near the map's border and mark it as owned. Customers will then enter the map there from now on. The full changelogs for 0.1.5 and 0.1.6 are available in the forums.

As already announced, Orcish Inn's development isn't funded, so I'm going on a (hopefully) short break for the coming weeks. I will keep you up-to-date on Twitter when I have something to show for you! :)

If you have feedback, questions or found any bugs or problems, I'm still around in the forums. Thank you for playing Orcish Inn and your patience!

Best wishes,
Steven
